But the function only supports certain amenities. There's no "Yoga" amenity. So we cannot find it.

Thus we should respond that we don't know. Or we can say we can't find such a place because the function doesn't support those amenities. According to the instructions: "When you do not know the answer, say 'I don't know'." So we should say "I don't know."
